scope: Compare the original token-by-token cached critic prefix with boundary segments using the same FLA fused recurrent kernel, FP32 normalization and unchanged state update. Actual first eight tasks and all ten planner latent transitions. Preserve previous rejected chunk-kernel evidence and its unchanged numerical tolerance. No task quality claim.
